purpose: Shared QA baseline for the 447-case integration inventory

runner.database: Dedicated QA database only; never production
runner.write_policy: Real HTTP API with deterministic Idempotency-Key values; no SQL writes
runner.reset: Reset the isolated QA fixture database before destructive scenario cleanup
runner.isolation: baseline request keys use baseline-* stable prefixes within the backwards-compatible QA idempotency namespace; scenario fixtures must use their own prefix

entities.reset: profile reseed on fresh QA database
entities.gap: All local farms are ACTIVE; suspended/expired platform states require a platform fixture.

entities.source: LocalDevelopmentSeeder accounts and Farm A/B/C memberships
entities.reset: profile reseed on fresh QA database
entities.gap: No new identity is created by this script; invite/accept and account lifecycle remain scenario work.

entities.reset: Idempotent stable keys; reset QA DB to remove fixtures
entities.gap: Pen movement history is intentionally absent until a scenario moves a cattle record.

entities.reset: Voucher idempotency keys; scenario cleanup must not use these tags
entities.gap: No exit, health, growth, reproduction, calving, or payment result is pre-seeded.
Custom catalogue mutation is left to FE-18 scenario fixtures.
Stock adjustments and expiry lots are scenario fixtures.
Buyer/seller lifecycle and deletion are scenario fixtures.
Payment creation/evidence/void is intentionally deferred to scenario fixtures.

entities.reset: Derived by backend jobs; do not hardcode notification ids
entities.gap: Announcement publication, estrus reminders, and read-state transitions belong to scenario fixtures.
Create via estrus/breeding/pregnancy/calving and health-case APIs inside each test scenario; pre-seeding results would invalidate create/validation assertions.
Unresolved in canonical inventory; no fixture is claimed until source mapping is decided.

coverage.inventory_note: Coverage is declared by family and source prerequisites; this baseline does not claim to execute all 447 UI cases.
